entry.dc:title: Capacitance loss and ESR evolution of metallized film capacitors under repetitive pulses
entry.dc:description: A detailed protocol for measuring capacitance and ESR every 1000 shots is provided. The ESR doubles when capacitance drops 2%.
entry.prism:publicationName: IEEE Transactions on Dielectrics and Electrical Insulation

entry.dc:title: A review of film capacitor ageing
entry.dc:description: This review summarises ageing mechanisms but does not provide reproducible experimental recipes.
entry.prism:publicationName: Journal of Physics D: Applied Physics
